quoted_tweet.text:
"ARAY KO!"

By: SASS ROGANDO SASOT
Class...our lesson for today is the "mga"

Christ Tan, a political analyst, says hindi tanggap ng "mga" tao na si VP Sara papalit kay President BBM.

First, under the constitution, the VP really replaces the President. IF you are against that, then let us just throw away the constitution.

Second, "mga" means plural. Plural requires a number. As far as we know, VP Sara was voted by MAJORITY as Vice President. Ergo, they accept that if the President cannot fulfill his duties, they VOTED for Sara to replace him.

Third, "mga" requires identification of current number. As far as we are concerned, in 2025, Bong Go was #1 senator. It's like a referendum of which side of the political equation holds the number. 

So class, whenever you say "mga", you must support it with "math"...Pwede rin namang "mga" rerefs to "Kakampinks" and "BBM supporters"...Sure. Marami kayo but hindi kasing dami ng supporters ni Sara...Otherwise...kung mas marami kayo eh di sana ang #1 Senator na nanalo ngayong 2025 eh galing sa inyo. Kaso hindi. Grow up and do the math before you claim your "mga" is greater than others "mga." Ayaw nyo kay Sara. Sure. You can speak for your own "mga." But the MGA that matters in politics is the result of elections and not of your imagination. Kayo itong ilang beses nang natalo sa ELEKSYON tapos kayo pa mayabang? Aba uy.. Kayo ang hindi tanggap...kaya nga natalo kayo...ilang beses.. So please lang naman kaunting self-awareness.

Ilang kalsada sa Quezon City ang inikutan ng Swift Traffic Action Group ngayong araw bilang bahagi ng anti-illegal parking operations.

20th Avenue, Maginhawa St., at Masaya St. ang sinuyod ng grupo para hulihin ang mga sasakyang naka-illegal parking at maisyuhan ng tiket ang mga lumabag sa tamang dress code o iyong mga naka-tsinelas habang nagmamaneho ng motor o kaya'y mali o walang helmet na suot.

Nasa 121 ang kabuuang nahuli kung saan 114 ang nakunan ng video gamit ang mga body-worn camera para sa non-contact apprehension habang pito naman ang agad na natiketan.
